title: Unit – 3 : Session – 10 : SLO – 1  |  Use Java Swing Widgets for GUI Creation
sections: 1. JButton — the Swing class used to create a push button.
2. ButtonGroup — groups radio buttons so that only one can be selected at a time.
3. JTextArea — displays multiple lines of editable text.
4. HIDE_ON_CLOSE — setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.HIDE_ON_CLOSE) hides the frame when it is closed.
1. FALSE — JTextField accepts a single line of text; selecting from a list is done with JComboBox or JList.
2. FALSE — a JComboBox is not editable by default; setEditable(true) is required to allow free typing.
1. B — JLabel displays a non-editable line of text.
2. C — JRadioButton (inside a ButtonGroup) allows exactly one choice among mutually exclusive options.
1. Identify the output: B — a window titled "Test" appears showing the label text "Welcome".
2. Find the error: C — neither setSize() nor pack() is called, so the frame would open with zero/default size; call f.setSize(...) or f.pack() before setVisible(true).
